1 Reading the document · every page, its images and captions (1-3 min)
2 Uploads tagged as untrusted · any instruction inside them is treated as data, not a command

Read 14 pages (reused an earlier pass) · MICAM × Livetrend가 FW25/26 시즌을 위한 AI·데이터 기반 풋웨어 트렌드 프레스 키트로, 여성·남성·키즈 시장을 아우르는 4개 매크로 트렌드와 핵심 제품/색/소재 방향을 제시합니다. 인스타그램·이커머스·패션쇼·소비자 관심 데이터를 근거로, 재질·형상·디테일 신호를 시각 예시와 함께 요약했습니다.

signals.label: 소프트 유틸리티 하이커
evidence: Hiking boots remain an essential for menswear collections. Now more subtle colorways and elevated material choices balance its utilitarian function.

low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole, hiker-inspired D-ring eyelets and ghillie lacing, suede mudguard and rubberized toe bumper, pastel-tonal upper panels, higher sidewall and lug-leaning tread for a soft utility read.

signals.label: 퍼리·셰어링 텍스처
evidence: furry and fuzzy materials provide textures that celebrate the raw beauty of nature.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole, hairy-suede quarters and vamp, shearling-lined collar and tongue; slightly thicker sidewall for a cocooning feel and winterized traction tread.

signals.label: 글로시/페이턴트 광택
evidence: It elevates the classic Chelsea boot with a super glossy, patent finish and exudes a chic yet edgy spirit.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole in high-shine patent leather, minimized seam count, polished foxing sidewall and clean court herringbone tread.

signals.label: 메탈 하드웨어 & 멀티 스트랩
evidence: Thick laces, studs, zippers or buckles are crucial to add a subcultural appeal to the usually chic and clean shoe.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole, instep strap with mini metal buckle, metal eyelets and subtle stud accents at quarters; standard cupsole with perimeter foxing and classic tread.

signals.label: 모노크롬/듀오톤 컬러웨이
evidence: In sleek monochrome or duo-tone leather options it enhances the modern minimal look despite the soccer retro inpiration.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole in single-color or two-tone panel blocking, tonal laces and edge paint; clean sidewall and standard court tread.

signals.label: 청키 러그·크리퍼 솔 볼륨
evidence: Chunky lugsoles and metal elements add an even harsher edge to classic combat styles, while glossy leather finishings add an elegant twist that balances the rough appeal of the shoe.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and an exaggerated cupsole, stepped sidewall detailing and micro-lugged perimeter; durable rubber with deeper court-lug tread.

signals.label: 날 선 아웃라인·기하학적 토
evidence: Key details include more complex buckled straps and geometric toe shapes.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole, pointed toebox overlay and squared eyestay paneling; crisp seam geometry and tight topline radius on a clean cupsole.

signals.label: 애니멀리어(프린트/엠보스)
evidence: From prints to embossed finishings, the animal print adds a rebellious but fashionable twist undertone to shoes.
low-top court sneaker with leather upper and cupsole using leopard haircalf or reptile-embossed leather on quarter and heel panels; clean sidewall and classic herringbone tread.

directions.title: Square toe with a low block heel
directions.summary: The two strongest signals in this band, combined. It runs on the existing LST-2024-11 last, so development stays cheap.

directions.title: Chunky sole, played for volume
directions.summary: The chunky sole scores high culturally, pulled back to a volume that fits the brand. The new outsole mould, one per size, is the cost to watch — feasibility is the low index here.

directions.title: Soft classic, refined
directions.summary: Keeps the classic penny silhouette and improves the fit with suede and a gore panel. Restock signals back this one, so it is the safe axis.
